source: USDA FNS — SNAP Case and Procedural Error Rates (CAPER)
scope: California (US shown where the per-year PDF lists it)
unit: percent of negative actions (denial/termination/suspension) with a case or procedural error
notes: FY2020 and FY2021 absent: USDA waived SNAP QC reporting during COVID-19 (404 on the data portal).

US national parsed only where the per-year PDF lists it (FY2024 = 43.81).
